comparison: The three dispatched routes were compared after their results. The J-fiber route reduced its open part to the generic J sum of the whole weighted diagonal and to a direct first mass M_w. The slope-product route improved the right energy E(mu) feeding the separate one-match criterion and showed that route cannot reach the one-match target through E(mu). Neither result reduces to the other's estimate at the same hypotheses and scale: the diagonal and the one-match covariance remain separate obligations. The cold route shares no estimate with either. No overlap group is recorded.
